body: Dress up, and don't hold back. Think formal, with personality: bold block colours, a bit of sparkle and a disco feel.

images.alt: A collage of suits in bold colours: powder blue, burgundy, mustard, emerald velvet and pink, with patterned ties, embroidered jackets and striped blazers.
